decks.notes: Utilizing a combination of evasion, disruption, and aggressive creatures, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly with a mix of unblockable creatures and removal spells. By combining the evasion of Spyglass Siren and Deep-Cavern Bat with removal like Go for the Throat and Cut Down, the deck can control the board while dealing damage efficiently. Additionally, cards like Anoint with Affliction and Faerie Mastermind provide card advantage and disruption to further disrupt opponents' plans. The deck's key strategy revolves around tempo and consistency in putting pressure on opponents early on.

The concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells in order to quickly deplete their resources and secure a victory. The deck focuses on a combination of creature abilities and spell effects that can control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By utilizing a mix of powerful creatures and control spells, the deck aims to apply consistent pressure on the opponent while maintaining a strong defensive position. Additionally, the deck includes cards that provide card advantage and card draw to ensure a steady stream of resources throughout the game.

This Dimir Aggro deck focuses on disrupting the opponent with cards like Spyglass Siren and Gix, Yawgmoth Praetor, while also utilizing Faerie Mastermind and Deep-Cavern Bat for aggressive creature attacks. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Go for the Throat and Cut Down, while utilizing cards like Enduring Curiosity and Phantom Interference to maintain card advantage. Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Aclazotz, Deepest Betrayal provide powerful finishers for the deck, while cards like Preacher of the Schism and Anoint with Affliction help to maintain pressure on the opponent.

This deck focuses on combining powerful creatures with the ability to bring them back from the graveyard, creating a powerful reanimation combo. By utilizing cards like Zombify and Evangel of Synthesis, you can quickly fill the battlefield with high-impact creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and Valgavoth. The deck also includes support cards like Anoint with Affliction and Go for the Throat to control your opponent's board. With a mix of card draw, removal, and powerful creatures, this deck aims to overwhelm your opponent with a relentless onslaught of threats.

This deck focuses on consistently applying pressure to the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures and removal spells. By using cards like Faerie Mastermind and Spyglass Siren to disrupt the opponent's strategy while using cards like Deep-Cavern Bat and Floodpits Drowner to attack aggressively, the deck aims to quickly finish off the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Gix, Yawgmoth Praetor for powerful late-game threats. The strategy also includes protecting your creatures with cards like Spell Stutter and Preacher of the Schism while maintaining card advantage with Enduring Curiosity.

This Golgari Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and removal spells. It aims to control the board early on with cards like Llanowar Elves and Go for the Throat, while also utilizing powerful creatures like Mosswood Dreadknight and Archfiend of the Dross to quickly end the game. The deck also includes some graveyard recursion with cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Glissa Sunslayer to maintain pressure on the opponent. Additionally, cards like Demolition Field and Shoot the Sheriff provide additional removal options to keep the opponent on the back foot.

This Golgari Aggro deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Mosswood Dreadknight and Glissa Sunslayer to quickly overwhelm the opponent. With support from cards like Go for the Throat and Cut Down, the deck aims to control the board and maintain pressure on the opponent. Additional removal spells like Maelstrom Pulse and Duress help to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of cards like Anoint with Affliction and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provide additional value and potential for powerful plays. Overall, this deck aims to be fast, efficient, and relentless in its pursuit of victory.

The main focus of this deck is to maintain control over the game by utilizing a combination of removal spells, discard spells, and powerful creatures. By steadily reducing the opponent's resources and threats, the player can establish dominance and ultimately win the game. The deck also aims to leverage the synergy between cards like Unholy Annex/Ritual Chamber and Archfiend of the Dross to generate incremental advantages and close out the game efficiently. Overall, the Mono Black Control deck seeks to disrupt the opponent's plans while establishing a formidable board presence.

The focus of this deck is on using a combination of removal spells, hand disruption, and powerful creatures to control the game and outvalue the opponent. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Go for the Throat and Anoint with Affliction, while also deploying threats like Archfiend of the Dross and Glissa Sunslayer to pressure the opponent. The mana base allows for consistent casting of spells, and cards like Sentinel of the Nameless City and Dreams of Steel and Oil provide additional value. Overall, the deck seeks to outlast opponents and grind out wins through attrition.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay using the Golgari color combination. It includes powerful creatures like Archfiend of the Dross and Glissa Sunslayer, along with removal spells like Go for the Throat and Maelstrom Pulse. The deck also includes enchantments like Mosswood Dreadknight and Restless Cottage to enhance board presence. With a mix of efficient creatures, removal, and support cards, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Liliana of the Veil provides additional late-game power and disruption.

The main focus of this deck is to establish control over the game through utilizing powerful white control cards such as Beza, the Bounding Spring, Caretaker's Talent, and Enduring Innocence. The deck aims to disrupt opponents' strategies with cards like Get Lost and Lay Down Arms, while also gaining card advantage and protection with cards like Soul Partition and Virtue of Loyalty. The deck also includes a strong finisher in the form of Archangel Elspeth, making it difficult for opponents to mount a comeback once the control has been established.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Monastery Swiftspear, Burst Lightning, and Emberheart Challenger, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of cards like Manifold Mouse and Thornspire Verge helps to generate additional value and keep the pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes protection spells like Snakeskin Veil and removal spells like Scorching Dragonfire to handle threats from the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to win the game by staying on the offensive and closing out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive red creatures and burn spells. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early in the game through efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger, while finishing them off with direct damage spells like Lightning Strike and Burst Lightning. The inclusion of cards like Monstrous Rage and Witchstalker Frenzy ensures that the deck can deal with opposing threats effectively while maintaining its aggressive game plan. The strategy is to be proactive and fast, aiming to win the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruption spells. The key strategy is to quickly establish a board presence using powerful creatures like Archfiend of the Dross and Mosswood Dreadknight, while also utilizing cards like Duress and Go for the Throat to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Anoint with Affliction and Glissa Sunslayer further adds to the deck's ability to control the battlefield and outpace the opponent. Ultimately, the goal is to apply pressure early and maintain it throughout the game.

The key strategy of this Dimir Aggro deck is to utilize Faerie Mastermind's ability to draw cards whenever a creature is returned to your hand, combined with Enduring Curiosity to keep the card advantage flowing. Spyglass Siren and Floodpits Drowner provide control elements, while Anoint with Affliction and Cut Down clear the way for aggressive creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Deep-Cavern Bat to finish off opponents. The deck also includes disruption with Duress and Negate, as well as removal with Go for the Throat and Unstoppable Slasher. Phantom Interference provides an extra win condition if needed.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and disruption spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By playing powerful threats like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Floodpits Drowner, combined with removal like Go for the Throat and Cut Down, the deck aims to apply constant pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Phantom Interference and Spectral Sailor provide additional versatility and ways to control the board. With a mix of evasive threats and disruptive spells, this deck aims to close out games quickly and efficiently.
